summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TEST MODE feature for Sole Serenity. All backend APIs working perfectly (12/12 tests passed). Frontend test mode toggle, admin label generation, and customer order flow verified. Test mode successfully prevents real Royal Mail API calls while providing simulated labels for safe testing.

Backend: Pricing calculation - Quick single pair £15 + £14.99 = £29.99
Backend: Pricing calculation - Deep single pair £20 + £14.99 = £34.99
Backend: Pricing calculation - Mixed 4 pairs (2 quick + 2 deep) £70 + £29.99 = £99.99
Backend: Order creation with photo upload
Backend: Admin approve order

Backend: Admin status changes work (SHOES_RECEIVED -> CLEANING -> READY_FOR_RETURN -> DELIVERED -> COMPLETED)
